settings.intro_highlight: The Circus Magnifier LED delivers distortion-free optics and shadow-free illumination, engineered specifically to eliminate practitioner visual fatigue during detailed skin analyses and precision aesthetic treatments. Hand-assembled to strict North American manufacturing standards, this heavy-duty workstation tool combines fluid mechanical positioning with industrial-grade durability, ensuring seamless operational performance in high-volume clinics.
settings.custom_description: Circus Magnifier LED is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including Estheticians, Clinical Spa Therapists, Lash Technicians, and Permanent Makeup Artists. Its precision-engineered structure targets visual fatigue during extended treatment sessions, enabling sharper focus on treatment execution and operational efficiency. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, microdermabrasion, brow sculpting, or PMU, this precision tool adjusts to your modality-specific positioning with intuitive one-hand control and instant-response calibration.
settings.subtitle: High-Definition Clarification & Shadow-Free LED Illumination
settings.secondary_description: Standard magnifying lamps frequently suffer from internal spring fatigue, plastic joint degradation, and lens clouding, leading to drifting arms and distorted vision within months of high-volume use. The Equipro difference lies in our industrial-grade, fully enclosed spring-balanced steel articulated arm and premium optical-grade glass. Equipro's design completely encloses the mechanical components to eliminate pinching hazards and maintain consistent tension, providing a reliable, drift-free extension that outlasts standard commercial imports by years.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Securely mount the magnifier stem into your compatible Equipro salon cart, space-saving wall bracket, or mobile caster base.
Connect the power cable to a grounded AC outlet and verify that the articulation tension knobs are adjusted to your preferred resistance.
Open the integrated hygienic dust cover to expose the 3.5D or 5D optical lens.
Grip the ergonomic lens head handle and smoothly position the light field approximately 8 to 12 inches directly above the target treatment zone.
Activate the power switch to illuminate the high-intensity LED array, and close the cover immediately following completion of the procedure to protect the glass optics.

Never leave the magnifying lens exposed to direct sunlight, as the glass lens can act as a convex burning glass and create a severe fire hazard. Always close the protective dust cover when the lamp is not actively in use.
Avoid forcing the articulated arm beyond its structural 47-inch maximum extension or twisting the lamp head past its engineered mechanical limit stops.
Ensure the electrical housing and LED light array do not come into direct contact with streaming vapors, chemical oversprays, or liquid skincare solutions.

settings.question: Does the unit include a cover to protect the optical glass?
settings.answer: Yes, it features an integrated flip-up protective dust cover that shields the lens from ambient dust and prevents solar glare hazards when not in use.

settings.question: What is the maximum height range and mechanical reach of the arm?
settings.answer: The spring-balanced articulated arm extends up to 47 inches (119 cm) with drift-free positioning.

settings.question: What diopter options are available for this lamp?
settings.answer: It is available in 3.5 Diopters (1.875x magnification) under SKU 63603 and 5 Diopters (2.25x magnification) under SKU 63605.

settings.question: How do I perform routine maintenance on the magnifying lamp?
settings.answer: Clean the optical glass lens with a microfiber cloth and non-abrasive optical lens cleaner, and wipe down the steel arm with clinical disinfectant wipes.

settings.question: Is assembly required for this professional magnifier lamp?
settings.answer: The lamp head and arm come pre-assembled; simply insert the mounting stem into an approved Equipro trolley, wall mount, or rolling base.

settings.question: What type of commercial warranty coverage is included?
settings.answer: The Circus Magnifier LED is backed by a 1-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty covering parts and labor.
